(i) Define the sum C = A + B such that C becomes a (maximal) closed operator on X and Cx = Ãx + B̃x for all x ∈ X and some extrapolated operators A and B. artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a Banach space, and let $A$ and $B$ be (in general unbounded) linear operators on $X$, each of which generates a strongly continuous one-parameter semigroup (a $C_0$-semigroup) on $X$. Recall that for a generator $A$ with semigroup $(T(t))_{t\ge 0}$ one can construct the extrapolation space $X_{-1}$, the completion of $X$ with respect to the norm $\|x\|_{-1} = \|R(\lambda,A)x\|$ for some $\lambda$ in the resolvent set, and the extrapolated operator $\widetilde A : X \to X_{-1}$, which is the unique continuous extension of $A : D(A) \to X$ to $X$ viewed inside $X_{-1}$.

Address the following two-part problem:

(i) Give a definition of the sum $C = A + B$ such that $C$ is a (maximal) closed linear operator on $X$ and such that, for every $x \in D(C)$, one has
$$Cx = \widetilde A x + \widetilde B x,$$
where $\widetilde A$ and $\widetilde B$ are the extrapolated operators associated with $A$ and $B$ respectively. The domain $D(C)$ should be chosen so that $C$ is maximal among closed operators on $X$ satisfying this identity.

(ii) Determine general conditions on the pair $(A,B)$ under which the operator $C$ defined in part (i) is itself the generator of a $C_0$-semigroup on $X$. The conditions should be sufficiently broad to recover, as special cases, the classical perturbation theorems for $C_0$-semigroups (bounded perturbation theorem, Desch–Schappacher perturbation, Miyadera–Voigt perturbation, and Weiss–Staffans-type perturbation), thereby providing a unified perturbation theory.
artifact.status_search_result: The general "A+B problem" for generators of $C_0$-semigroups is a long-standing open problem in operator semigroup theory. While classical partial answers exist (bounded perturbation theorem, Desch–Schappacher, Miyadera–Voigt, and Weiss–Staffans theorems), no fully unifying perturbation theory is currently known, and recent work continues to seek such a unification.

status_evidence.title: On Perturbations of Generators of C0-Semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: Given the generator A of a C0-semigroup on X, for which operators P is the sum A + P again a generator? Numerous results are known but no unifying theory is yet available.
status_evidence.claim: The A+B problem remains without a unifying theory.

status_evidence.title: On Weiss-Staffans Perturbations of Semigroup Generators (dissertation)
status_evidence.snippet: Conditions on a triple (A,B,C) implying that A+BC generates a C0-semigroup, generalizing Weiss-Staffans perturbation.
status_evidence.claim: Active research provides partial unifications via Weiss–Staffans-type perturbation frameworks.
